description: Glass banner surfacing that the partner last edited this budget. Promotes the current tiny header caption into a first-class, color-independent co-edit context row. Renders only when updated_by exists and !== currentUserId.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601; rendered as relative time. Omit the time half if absent.

partner.description: Which household partner, for glyph + tint

behavior: Render condition: budgetData.updated_by && budgetData.updated_by !== currentUserId. Text = 'Last edited by {editorName || "partner"}' + ' · {relativeTime(updatedAt)}' (time half omitted if updatedAt missing).

accessibility.label: Last edited by {editorName}, {relative time}
accessibility.colorIndependent: Meaning carried by glyph shape + the words 'Last edited by {name}', not tint; partner A vs B differ by glyph shape as well as color
